description: This file defines the final class 'Query' in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, containing static methods for parsing query strings into arrays and building query strings from arrays. It provides utilities for handling URL query parameters within the Guzzle HTTP client library.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to parse query strings into arrays and build query strings from arrays, used internally within Guzzle's HTTP handling.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL query string into an associative array, decoding according to the specified encoding and handling duplicate keys by creating arrays.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a URL query string from an array of parameters, encoding according to the specified encoding constant.
